items.title_kr: Kohl's, Walmart 출신 fashion alum을 새로운 chief merchant로 영입
items.title_en: Kohl’s names Walmart fashion alum as chief merchant
items.body_kr: Kohl's가 Walmart 출신의 패션 전문가를 새로운 chief merchant로 선임하며 merchandise 전략 강화에 나섰습니다. 향후 product assortment와 private brand 개편 속도에 주목할 필요가 있습니다.
items.body_en: Kohl's has appointed a Walmart fashion alum as its new chief merchant to strengthen merchandising strategies. Vendor teams should monitor upcoming shifts in product assortment and private brand direction.

items.title_kr: Kohl's, DoorDash delivery partnership을 통해 back-to-school category 확장
items.title_en: DoorDash adds Gap, Barnes & Noble, Carter’s and Kohl’s for school supplies
items.body_kr: Kohl's expanded its delivery channel for back-to-school merchandise, including apparel and dorm gear, through a DoorDash partnership. This highlights ongoing changes in retail channels emphasizing e-commerce convenience.

items.title_kr: Abercrombie & Fitch, Q2 record sales 기록했으나 Hollister comp sales는 3% 하락
items.title_en: Abercrombie & Fitch Posted Record Sales, but Hollister Comparable Sales Fell 3%
items.body_kr: While Abercrombie & Fitch posted record sales, Hollister comparable sales dropped 3%. Divergent brand growth may prompt adjustments in inventory allocation and marketing strategies.

items.title_kr: Kohl's reports Sephora sales down 4% raising red flag for partnership
items.body_kr: Sephora sales within Kohl's dropped 4%, raising red flags for a key growth partnership. Vendors should monitor potential impacts on overall store traffic and cross-category sell-through.

items.title_kr: Abercrombie & Fitch, tariff refund 효과와 Q2 earnings beat로 주가 36% 급등
items.title_en: Abercrombie's Shares Rise 36% on Q2 Earnings Beat on Tariff Refunds
items.body_kr: Abercrombie & Fitch shares surged following a Q2 earnings beat bolstered by tariff refunds. Strong margins are expected to positively influence future sourcing and pricing strategies.

items.title_kr: Kohl's, 'KPop Demon Hunters' inspired collection 출시하며 Gen Alpha 공략
items.title_en: Kohl’s ‘KPop Demon Hunters’ inspired collection: Products and availability
items.body_kr: Kohl's launched a 'KPop Demon Hunters' inspired collection incorporating trendy IP. This unique merchandise aims to drive store traffic by targeting young consumer demand.
